programme.desc: S6 E16 — El dinero es un motivo Todo Casey, en Illinois, es sospechosa cuando descubren que un incendio no mató a Scott Collins: fue un asesinato. Los secretos revelados sobre su vida no son suficientes para llegar al asesino. Pero su pastor tiene una clave.
programme.title: Muerte en el pueblo
Murder in the Heartland

programme.desc: S1 E1 — El miedo viaja rápido En Aurora, Indiana, no hubo ningún homicidio hasta que asesinaron a Leigh Jennings en su propia casa. Los residentes se horrorizaron cuando la querida peluquera apareció muerta. Cualquiera podría ser el asesino.
programme.title: Muerte en el pueblo
Murder in the Heartland

programme.desc: S1 E2 — La hermana amorosa Elizabeth Baune era un pilar de la comunidad hasta que la apuñalaron a muerte en su casa. La ciudad rural de Payette, Idaho, queda horrorizada por la trágica muerte de la maestra.
programme.title: Muerte en el pueblo
Murder in the Heartland

programme.desc: S10 E1 — Desaparecimento noturno Kirsten Brueggeman, una mujer de 26 años de Indianápolis, desapareció el 2 de enero de 2021. Las cámaras de seguridad la captan caminando sola en un estacionamiento y ese fue el último avistamiento conocido de Kirsten.
programme.title: Desaparecidos
Disappeared

programme.desc: S10 E5 — Empresaria desaparecida El 24 de abril de 2021, la exitosa empresaria y madre de cinco hijos Dee Ann Warner desaparece de la granja familiar. La familia sospecha de que su esposo Dale tiene algo que ver con su desaparición, pero Dale insiste en que solo se fue.
programme.title: Desaparecidos
Disappeared

programme.desc: S18 E3 — Mamá dijo que me estaba muriendo Cuando Teresa revela que su hija Hannah, de siete años, padece una enfermedad terminal, la comunidad las apoya. Hannah está aterrorizada. Entonces, la impactante verdad sale a la luz: todo fue una terrible y cruel mentira.
programme.title: La casa del mal
Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: S2 E5 — El trabajo soñado David Pauley estaba desempleado y se postuló por Craigslist a un empleo que parecía perfecto: casero de una finca en Ohio. Pero tan pronto como lo contratan desaparece y resulta ser que él no es el primer desaparecido allí.
programme.title: Red de mentiras
Web of Lies

programme.desc: S2 E7 — La novia perfecta Indle King, de 36 años, corteja en línea a la hermosa Anastasia Solovieva, de 18 años. Ella viaja desde su casa en Kirguistán a Seattle para casarse con él, pero su sueño americano se convierte en una pesadilla.
programme.title: Red de mentiras

programme.title: Silencio mortal
Dead Silent

programme.desc: S3 E2 — En el bosque Luego de que Heather Young y su novio se mudan a la tranquila Península inferior de Michigan, una pelea termina en un resultado explosivo y aterrador.
programme.title: Silencio mortal
Dead Silent

programme.desc: S3 E3 — La imagen del mal Una cena perfecta termina en una pesadilla en la Universidad de Arkansas cuando Dominique 'Nicky' Hurd y una compañera de clase se convierten en blancos de un depredador peligroso.
programme.title: Silencio mortal
Dead Silent

programme.title: Desaparecidos
Disappeared

programme.desc: S1 E5 — En las sombras La búsqueda de una mujer embarazada de veinte años termina mientras se intensifica la búsqueda de otra mujer desaparecida. La ciudad de Chillicothe, Ohio, busca respuestas a seis casos.
programme.title: El misterio de las mujeres desaparecidas
The Vanishing Women

programme.desc: S1 E6 — Lo que pasó esa noche La policía sigue una pista en un pueblo cercano. Además, comienza el juicio de Jason McCrary, acusado de asesinar a Timberly Claytor.
programme.title: El misterio de las mujeres desaparecidas
The Vanishing Women

programme.desc: S2 E3 — Sobreviviendo al leñador de Washington Por primera vez, los crímenes de Warren Forrest salen a la luz cuando una de sus sobrevivientes cuenta su historia en esta exclusiva que revela los secretos del asesino condenado dos veces y sospechoso de ser un asesino en serie.
programme.title: Revista People investiga: sobreviviendo al asesino
People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer

programme.desc: S2 E4 — Sobreviviendo al asesino por placer Amber Carter y sus hijos se esconden en 2020 para mantenerse a salvo de su exnovio abusivo. Al mismo tiempo, un asesino serial acecha el área de Dallas, disparando a residentes sin motivo aparente, hasta que llega a la puerta de Amber.
programme.title: Revista People investiga: sobreviviendo al asesino
People Magazine Investigates: Surviving a Serial Killer

programme.desc: S6 E11 — Creo que puedo ser más astuto que Dios En la mañana de Navidad, dos cuerpos aparecen junto a la autopista. Cuando los detectives detienen al asesino, descubren a un psicópata radical con una fijación por las armas y fantasías violentas sobre misiones de rescate.
programme.title: Rasgos de un psicópata
Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S6 E12 — Solo quería lastimarla Cuando una joven desaparece, los detectives sospechan del esposo del que se había separado. Aunque se muestra tranquilo al ser interrogado, descubren a un psicópata impulsivo y dominado por la ira, incapaz de aceptar el rechazo.
programme.title: Rasgos de un psicópata
Signs of a Psychopath

programme.desc: S7 E3 — Las noches que no recuerdo En las mañanas, cuando Joylynn Martínez despertaba no podía recordar la noche anterior, siempre se decía a sí misma que debía haber bebido demasiado. Nunca sospechó que su propio marido fuera el responsable o que apenas estaba empezando.
programme.title: La casa del mal
Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: S2 E1 — El sargento y la muchacha La estudiante de secundaria Michell Miller se une al programa Futuros Soldados como un paso preliminar para alistarse en el Ejército. Pero una relación prohibida con su reclutador pone en riesgo su carrera en el ejército y su futuro.
programme.title: Víctimas del amor
Forbidden: Dying for Love

programme.desc: S2 E2 — ¿Me viste? Debora Gail Moody desapareció de su casa de Ludowici, Georgia. Pasa una década y no hay respuestas, pero su familia sigue buscándola. 11 años después, una confesión revela los detalles.
programme.title: Homicidio en el pueblo
Hometown Homicide

programme.desc: S2 E6 — En las profundidades John y Liz Calvert desaparecieron en 2008 en Hilton Head, Carolina del Sur. Amigos, investigadores y reporteros locales no creen posible que hayan desaparecido sin dejar rastros en un lugar tan pacífico.
programme.title: Homicidio en el pueblo
Hometown Homicide

programme.desc: S10 E9 — Me lo advirtieron, no escuché Jennifer Winter cae gravemente enferma y acepta la propuesta de matrimonio de Cristóbal Palacio, pero más que nada por necesidad para conseguir un seguro médico, sabe que es un arreglo por mera conveniencia.
programme.title: La casa del mal
Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: S2 E5 — Grabación y accidente Tras la grabación de su espectáculo local en el área rural de Vermont, Chrissy y Charlie Billis sufren un terrible accidente. Solo uno de ellos sobrevive. Pero grabaciones sugieren que detrás de lo sucedido hay una historia siniestra.
programme.title: Cuando el mal se disfraza
American Monster

programme.title: Cintas del crimen
The Murder Tapes

programme.desc: S1 E2 — Soy una buena chica Trabajando con su exnovia, los detectives tienden una trampa a Wuornos. Al entrar al interrogatorio, su historia impacta. Con entrevistas exclusivas a sus amigos, se revela cómo se convirtió en la asesina que conocemos hoy.
programme.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S1 E3 — El mundo lo sabrá El mundo finalmente ve el rostro de Aileen Wuornos. Cuando enfrenta el juicio, decide declarar por sí misma. Su historia impacta a todos al asegurar que los asesinatos fueron en defensa propia. Si el jurado no le cree, morirá.
programme.title: Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos

programme.desc: S2 E2 — La muerte de una Raiderette La policía encuentra a cuatro víctimas entre los restos humeantes de un incendio en una casa de Oklahoma City, y una de las víctimas era una de las protagonistas de la exitosa serie de televisión 'Cathouse'.
programme.title: Letalmente rubia
Lethally Blonde

programme.desc: S6 E1 — Sin final a la vista Debbie Puglisi está disfrutando de la vida con su marido de casi 25 años, Nino, en la nueva casa de sus sueños. Pero cuando un visitante inesperado pasa por el vecindario, el mundo entero de Debbie se convierte en su peor pesadilla.
programme.title: La peor pesadilla
Your Worst Nightmare

programme.desc: S6 E6 — Corazón oscuro Devastada por una pérdida personal, Heather Kelso empieza de nuevo en un lugar familiar y se enamora del carismático Gerry DeJesus. Pero los celos y otras amistades enterrarán una cuña mortal en el corazón de su relación.
programme.title: La peor pesadilla
Your Worst Nightmare

programme.desc: S6 E8 — No lo imaginé Tammie Craycraft Smith, una divorciada de 30 años, tiene dos trabajos. Pero su naturaleza confiada y su deseos de ser amada la dejan en una posición vulnerable que termina en engaño, venganza y consecuencias fatales.
programme.title: La peor pesadilla
Your Worst Nightmare

programme.desc: S11 E10 — Misterio en los Ozarks El 19 de mayo de 2022, Christopher Hoye abandona su propiedad en Ozark, Arkansas. Después de varias horas, la esposa de Christopher encuentra su auto cerca de un río. Semanas después, la desaparición sigue siendo un misterio.
programme.title: Desaparecidos
Disappeared

programme.desc: S7 E1 — El camino hacia la nada El universitario Bryce Laspisa se dirige a visitar a sus padres, pero algo misterioso le preocupa. Cuando encuentran su auto estrellado y abandonado, los investigadores y su familia tratan de hallar pistas en su rara conducta.
programme.title: Desaparecidos
Disappeared

programme.desc: S2 E6 — Los secretos de un soldado Un tirador mata a tiros a un soldado en su propia casa, pero tras la tragedia se esconde una familia destrozada por el sexo, la manipulación y secretos.
programme.title: Mamá, ¿puedo matar?
Mother, May I Murder?

programme.desc: S7 E1 — Fue Judith Cuando Corey Breininger era pequeño, su madrastra, Judith Hawkey, lo convenció de hacer algo horrible. Atormentado por la culpa, mantuvo el secreto durante años.
programme.title: La casa del mal
Evil Lives Here

programme.desc: S1 E3 — Psicópata suburbano Una madre es brutalmente asesinada en un suburbio de Georgia. Su vecina y mejor amiga recibe un disparo al día siguiente. La policía descubre una historia de engaño, que vincula los ataques y revela una conspiración entre madre e hijo.
programme.title: Mamá, ¿puedo matar?
Mother, May I Murder?

programme.desc: Obsesión fatal Corre el año 1978; en Rosamond, California, Tana Woolley es coronada reina de belleza del pueblo, pero apenas unas semanas después de que se vaya a vivir sola, la encantadora chica de 18 años es brutalmente asesinada.
programme.title: Reinas caídas
Beauty Queen Murders

programme.title: Reinas caídas

programme.desc: Hannah Upp, a 32-year-old teacher, vanishes in the U.S. Virgin Islands in 2017 in the chaotic days between two major hurricanes; her family and friends believe that she may be lost and wandering in a "fugue state," a rare form of temporary amnesia.
programme.title: Vanished in Paradise: The Untold Story

programme.desc: The disappearance of nursing student Holly Bobo remains a mystery for years; even after a tight-knit group of four men is charged in her abduction and murder, no one knows for sure who killed her or why.
programme.title: The Critical Witness

programme.desc: Elizabeth Vargas takes a fresh look at the most notorious cold-case murder in American history as new leads are tracked and new DNA tests are conducted; featuring an exclusive interview with John Ramsey, as well as many never-before-seen photos.
programme.title: Hunting JonBenét's Killer: The Untold Story

programme.desc: Elizabeth Vargas examines the largely unregulated dating app industry and explores the risks of dating online, which in some rare cases has led to assault, rape and even murder.
programme.title: Dating App Horrors: The Untold Story

programme.title: Open Water

programme.desc: Living in isolation in rural Maine, a widowed child psychologist (Naomi Watts) starts to believe that the ghost of a missing boy (Jacob Tremblay) is in her house during a dangerous ice storm.
programme.title: Shut In

programme.desc: Four college friends (Vanessa Hudgens, Selena Gomez, Ashley Benson, Rachel Korine) are arrested after robbing a restaurant to fund their spring-break trip. They land in more trouble when a drug and arms dealer bails them out to do some dirty work.
programme.title: Spring Breakers

programme.desc: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).
programme.title: Our Kind of Traitor

programme.desc: After moving from Montana, a youth and his new friends in Florida take on corrupt politicians and greedy developers in a fight to protect endangered owls.
programme.title: Hoot

programme.desc: Renowned ballroom dancer Pierre Dulaine takes a job at a New York City public school and helps his students meld hip-hop and classical styles to create a dance form.
programme.title: Take the Lead

programme.desc: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.
programme.title: Us

programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.
programme.title: It

programme.desc: Vatican officials send a priest and a novitiate to investigate the suicide of a young nun in Romania. They soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they encounter a demonic force that takes the shape of a nun.
programme.title: The Nun

programme.desc: An evil spreads in 1956 France as a priest is murdered, and Sister Irene once again comes face-to-face with the demonic nun Valak.
programme.title: The Nun II

programme.desc: A psychic and a federal agent hunt a serial killer.
programme.title: Solace

programme.desc: A couple's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when their friends agree to participate in a murder mystery party. They soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.
programme.title: Game Night

programme.desc: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.
programme.title: Dumb Money

programme.desc: Two women (Maggie Gyllenhaal, Viola Davis) contend with a powerful bureaucracy and a system mired in traditional thinking in order to transform their children's failing inner-city school.
programme.title: Won't Back Down

programme.desc: After glimpsing his future, an ambitious politician (Matt Damon) battles the agents of Fate itself to be with the woman (Emily Blunt) he loves.
programme.title: The Adjustment Bureau

programme.desc: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.
programme.title: Enemy

programme.desc: On an empty road in the middle of the night, Shula stumbles across the body of her uncle. As the funeral unfolds, the cousins unveil the buried secrets of their Zambian family in a vibrant reckoning with the lies we tell ourselves.
programme.title: On Becoming a Guinea Fowl

programme.desc: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam.
programme.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam

programme.desc: Following a young woman into and out of an emotionally abusive relationship.
programme.title: I Love You Forever

programme.desc: The story of a band that went from backing up Bob Dylan to becoming one of the most influential groups of its era.
programme.title: Once Were Brothers: Robbie Robertson and The Band

programme.desc: In a dystopian society, single people must find a mate within 45 days or be transformed into an animal of their choice.
programme.title: The Lobster

programme.desc: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.
programme.title: Mickey 17

programme.desc: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.
programme.title: The Shape of Water

programme.desc: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.
programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer

programme.desc: A criminal (Vincent Cassel) hires a hypnotherapist (Rosario Dawson) to probe the mind of a brain-injured auctioneer (James McAvoy) to uncover the hiding place of a stolen painting.
programme.title: Trance

programme.desc: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.
programme.title: The Whistlers

programme.desc: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe.
programme.title: Aniara

programme.desc: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party.
programme.title: Joshy

programme.desc: Lucien Greaves co-founds the Satanic Temple, a religious movement that calls for a revolution to save the nation's soul.
programme.title: Hail Satan?

programme.desc: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.
programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer

programme.desc: The true story of Brian Banks, a high school football player who faces prison for a crime he didn't commit. Years later, with the support of the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of NFL stardom.
programme.title: Brian Banks

programme.desc: Hearing that the mythic Mavericks surf break is real, a teenage surfer (Jonny Weston) asks a local legend (Gerard Butler) to teach him how to ride the wave and live to tell the tale.
programme.title: Chasing Mavericks

programme.desc: A Princeton grad student becomes the protégé of an online-gambling tycoon whose shady dealings have attracted the attention of the FBI.
programme.title: Runner Runner

programme.desc: Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) forms an enduring bond with June Carter (Reese Witherspoon) and struggles with drug addiction on the way to music stardom.
programme.title: Walk the Line

programme.desc: In twelfth-century England, Robin Longstride and his band of marauders confront corruption in a local village and lead an uprising against the crown that will forever alter the balance of power.
programme.title: Robin Hood

programme.desc: Seven strangers, each with a secret to bury, meet at a run-down hotel in Lake Tahoe in the 1960s California. Over the course of a fateful night, they all get one last shot at redemption before everything goes wrong.
programme.title: Bad Times at the El Royale

programme.desc: Three oppressed workers (Jason Bateman, Charlie Day, Jason Sudeikis) devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their intolerable employers.
programme.title: Horrible Bosses

programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.
programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire

programme.desc: Parapsychologist Elise Rainier and her team travel to Five Keys, N.M., to investigate a claim of a haunting in her childhood home. She must soon confront and destroy her greatest fear, the demon that she accidentally set free years earlier.
programme.title: Insidious: The Last Key

programme.desc: Ignoring the eerie warning of a troubled mother, a social worker and her own children are drawn into a frightening supernatural realm. Their only hope of surviving the legendary ghost La Llorona is a disillusioned priest who practices mysticism.
programme.title: The Curse of La Llorona

programme.desc: Online friends receive an anonymous message that they will all die if they disconnect or call the police. The planned night of fun quickly turns deadly as each user becomes the target of something sinister while the others watch helplessly in terror.
programme.title: Unfriended: Dark Web

programme.desc: Two strangers' lives become inextricably bound together after an error by an air traffic controller (Scoot McNairy) causes the death of a construction foreman's (Arnold Schwarzenegger) wife and daughter.
programme.title: Aftermath

programme.desc: A Japanese detective (Pat Morita) and a Detroit detective (Jay Leno) team up to recover a stolen top-secret turbocharger.
programme.title: Collision Course

programme.desc: A former cop (Mark Wahlberg) becomes embroiled in a bigger scandal than he realized after being hired to tail the cheating wife of the mayor (Russell Crowe).
programme.title: Broken City

programme.desc: The Alto Knights follow two of New York's most notorious crime bosses and how their separate paths to power place them on a deadly collision course.
programme.title: The Alto Knights

programme.desc: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who returns to service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death.
programme.title: Beirut

programme.desc: A case of mistaken identity leaves an ATF agent (Samuel L. Jackson) squabbling with a talkative salesman (Eugene Levy) in his custody.
programme.title: The Man

programme.desc: After a 50-year-old woman's (Frances McDormand) daughter is murdered, she confronts the police (Caleb Landry Jones, Kerry Condon) in her town, using the billboards on the outskirts of town to begin a smear campaign against them.
programme.title: Three Billboards Outside Ebbing, Missouri

programme.desc: Everyday people flip the script on Wall Street and get rich by turning GameStop into one of the world's hottest companies. In the middle of everything is Keith Gill, a regular guy who starts it all by sinking his life savings into the stock.
programme.title: Dumb Money

programme.desc: A high-school senior (Freddie Highmore) has a fatalistic outlook on life but slowly starts to change his view after meeting a free-spirited classmate (Emma Roberts).
programme.title: The Art of Getting By

programme.desc: Rick and Fred, two husbands who are having difficulty in their marriages, are given a Hall Pass by their wives for one week, they can do whatever they want.
programme.title: Hall Pass

programme.desc: Desperate to reach his pregnant wife (Michelle Monaghan), a high-strung architect (Robert Downey Jr.) takes a road trip home with an annoying stranger (Zach Galifianakis).
programme.title: Due Date

programme.desc: A record-company employee (Jonah Hill) has just a few days to get a boozy British rock star (Russell Brand) to Hollywood for a big comeback concert.
programme.title: Get Him to the Greek

programme.desc: A couple and their two children must fight for survival when four masked strangers descend upon their beachfront home. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them.
programme.title: Us

programme.desc: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan.
programme.title: Opus

programme.desc: A man stranded in the Arctic after an airplane crash must decide whether to remain in the relative safety of his makeshift camp or to embark on a deadly trek through the unknown in hopes of making it out alive.
programme.title: Arctic

programme.desc: A down-and-out artist (Garrett Hedlund) has a dangerous and shocking encounter with an evil drifter (Oscar Isaac) in the desert, leading to terrifying consequences when the deadly stranger follows his unsuspecting victim home.
programme.title: Mojave

programme.desc: The Teen Titans gang crosses paths with the Nerdlucks from Space Jam.
programme.title: Teen Titans GO! See Space Jam

programme.desc: An armored-car driver (Zach Galifianakis) helps a flirty co-worker (Kristen Wiig) and her friends pull off a heist, then finds himself holding the bag after they double-cross him.
programme.title: Masterminds

programme.desc: Two old-school, unemployed salesmen internships at Google, then must compete with younger, smarter candidates for prime positions.
programme.title: The Internship

programme.desc: As an important presentation nears, a business partner (Vince Vaughn) agonizes over whether to tell his associate and friend (Kevin James) that he saw the man's wife out with another guy.

programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives: Sandwiches Guy Fieri invites three "Diners, Drive-Ins, and Dives" chefs to compete in a sandwich showdown; the chefs make a sandwich using nine ingredients or fewer and build a stacked and jacked sandwich with Sammie Whammies for a chance to earn $20,000.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S40 E04 — Dessert Deception Guy Fieri divides six chefs up into teams as they work alone in 10-minute shifts to create a winning plate; the chefs are surprised to learn that their grocery list featuring breakfast sandwich ingredients must be used to make a dessert.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S42 E02 — Best Noodles Ever Chefs Joe Sasto, Lee Anne Wong, and Justin Warner battle over noodles.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S41 E05 — Food Family Takeover Three restaurant crews featuring family and longtime employees compete.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S41 E02 — New Food Stars Guy Fieri welcomes three up-and-coming food stars with big social media followings to take part in a viral-worthy culinary competition; the competitors must prepare their signature dish using only the ingredients they can fit in a tiny shopping bag.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S15 E05 — DDD Holiday Showdown Guy gives the chefs gift boxes containing ingredients they must use in their holiday ham dish; they receive stockings filled with sweets and treats that must be included in their family holiday dinner.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S22 E10 — Guy's Holiday Dessert Games Guy Fieri has the chefs turn a savory classic, ravioli, into a holiday favorite, before challenging the remaining chefs to make a decadent chocolate dessert using sample ingredients stationed around the market.
programme.title: Guy's Grocery Games

programme.desc: S03 E04 — The Dark Arts Challenge James and Oliver challenge the teams to create showpieces inspired by Professors of Defense Against the Dark Arts; Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain are joined by guest judge Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto in the Defense Against the Dark Arts classroom.
programme.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking

programme.desc: S03 E05 — The Order of the Phoenix Challenge In tribute to The Order of the Phoenix, James and Oliver challenge the bakers to create cakes that feature tasting elements with 10 layers to echo the 10 floors of The Ministry of Magic, where judges Duff Goldman and Sarah Mountain will preside.
programme.title: Harry Potter: Wizards of Baking

programme.desc: S13 E05 — Elf Improvement A senior elf is retiring, and Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to create a farewell dessert that honors the elf's position in Santa's workshop, such as gift wrapper or reindeer stable hand; guest judge Stephanie Boswell joins Duff Goldman.
programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Holiday: Mall Santa's Village Host Josh Peck welcomes Santa, Mrs. Claus and an Elf as they hunt for hyperrealistic cakes hidden around a shopping mall Santa's Village. If they can see through expert baker JonnyCakes' sweet deceptions, they win up to $12,000!
programme.title: Sweet Deceit

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Holiday: Office Party Host Josh Peck welcomes three art supply company coworkers to an office holiday party, where they put their artistic eyes to the test hunting for six hyperrealistic sweets created by baker Ashley Holt for a chance to win up to $12,000.
programme.title: Sweet Deceit

programme.desc: S01 E03 — 12 Days of Elf-mas The Scout Elves want to play the "12 Days of Christmas" at their concert, but they mix up the lyrics; Duff Goldman tasks the teams with delivering a twisted-up "12 Days of Elfmas" showpiece.
programme.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E04 — The Reason for the Season The scout elves have some trouble tuning up Santa's sleigh, so Duff Goldman asks the teams to create a sleigh design that will wow Mr. Claus; two teams build inventive snow forts for a snowball fight between judges Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt.
programme.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E05 — It's Not Goodbye Forever The scout elves fly over their favorite places as they return to the North Pole, so Duff Goldman challenges the finalists to elf-ify a famous landmark; Kardea Brown and Ashley Holt award their Ambassadors of Confectionery Concoctions with $25,000.
programme.title: The Elf on the Shelf: Sweet Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E03 — I'm Dreaming of a Bright Christmas Host Jesse Palmer challenges the teams to create a holiday light show out of gingerbread and pair their glittering creations with the lightest of all desserts: choux pastry; judges Nacho Aguirre, Kardea Brown and Breegan Jane choose the winning team.
programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E01 — Best in Show The baking teams are tasked with creating holiday memory snow globe scenes in gingerbread; they must also make a treat using the most common baking ingredient to represent snow — coconut.
programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E02 — Have Yourself a Scary Little Christmas The Abominable Snowman inspires the challenge theme, "A Monster Christmas"; the teams must make an oozing caramel dessert to go with their display.
programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Holiday Window Shop 'til You Drop The best part of shopping at the holidays is seeing all the window decorations, so the baking teams are asked to turn their favorite holiday window scene into a gingerbread display with an animated element and a champagne dessert.
programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship: Gingerbread Showdown

programme.desc: S04 E07 — The Crew Builds a Giant Checkerboard; The Crew Builds a Corn Silo Rubble and Wheeler team up to construct a solution for a mysterious mess on Farmer Zoe's farm; coach Karima is throwing Checkers Day for all the Builder Cove kids; when everyone can't play together, Rubble and Crew save the day with construction.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S01 E06 — The Crew Builds a Skate Park; The Crew Builds a Tunnel The pups find out Auntie Crane is a secret skateboarding star, but while building a surprise skate park, they have to fix a cement mix mishap; Charger's favorite singer, Sierra Sparkle, is coming to town.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S07 E18 — Pups Save Little Hairy; Pups Save a Kooky Climber Big Hairy's little brother falls into a hole, and Tracker gets carried away by Big Hairy; Danny tries extreme rock climbing with Ace Sorenson.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S04 E15 — Pups Chill Out; Pups Save Farmer Alex Roger's frozen food delivery truck gets stuck in a ditch; farmer Yumi's animals stampede toward town.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S01 E25 — Pups Great Race; Pups Take the Cake The pups plan to race each other on Adventure Bay Race Day; Mr. Porter enters a cake competition.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S01 E15 — Pups Save a Hoedown; Pups Save Alex A herd of cows escapes from a train at the railway station; Alex decides that he wants to be a member of the PAW Patrol.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Pups and the Big Freeze; Pups Save a Basketball Game A winter ice storm causes trouble throughout Adventure Bay; Mayor Goodway challenges Mayor Humdinger's basketball team to a game.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S09 E16 — All Paws on Deck Ryder and his team of pups must take on 10-year-old genius Codi Gizmodi, who has her sights set on building her own high-tech city to replace Adventure Bay; joining the team are Everest, Tracker, Sweetie, Tuck and Ella, Rex, Liberty and more.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S05 E19 — Fogzilla! It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S03 E17 — Bubble Scrubbies! The Guppies perform a "soap opera" to teach Mr. Grouper about good hygiene.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E17 — It's a Lizard! When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S01 E02 — The Crayon Prix The Bubble Guppies learn about colors while car racing.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E20 — Bigfoot Crossing! On the hottest day of the year, Rangers Goby and Gil's job is to make sure pedestrians reach the lake safely; however, Bigfoot causes issues when he removes the stop signs from the park.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E18 — Sir Nonny the Nice! Nonny is on a quest to become a real knight.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Bubble Puppy! The Bubble Guppies learn how to care for pets when Gil wants to adopt a puppy.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E25 — Escape From Volcano Island! Skipper Molly and First Mate Gil are shipwrecked on Volcano Island, and it's about to erupt; parts of their boat start to mysteriously disappear.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E07 — Genie in a Bubble! When Nonny, Gil and Zooli conjure a genie, she agrees to grant a wish to whoever brings her the most precious gift.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E13 — Too Bright for Movie Night! If the Moon People can find a way to make it dark during the day, the Sun People agree to turn off their giant night light so the Moon People can enjoy their movie night.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S06 E10 — The Jaw-some Sharkventure! Zooli and her crew of marine biologists escort their new friends Baby Shark and his pilot fish, William, to visit Baby Shark's great-great-great-great-great Uncle Slow Mo and help them escape the determined fisherman who's chasing them.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S04 E04 — Guppy Movers! When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E22 — Bubble Puppysaurus! When small-town "puppy-saurus" Bubble Puppy gets picked to go against the reigning champ Boom Boom T. rex in the Tough Roarier competition, it's a battle of strength, speed and, above all, heart.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S03 E25 — Super Guppies! When Molly and Gil bring a comic book to school, the Guppies are inspired, and they all want to be superheroes.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: Champion Daddy Pig; Chatterbox; Mr. Fox's Van; Chloe's Big Friends; Gym Class Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper; Suzy thinks that Peppa talks too much; Mr. Fox finds three clocks in the back of his van; Peppa and George go to play with their cousin Chloe; the children attend Grampy Rabbit's gym class.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: Clubhouse Takeaway; Walkie Talkies; Peppa's Office; What Babies Do; Lenses Suzy describes a takeout meal she had; Grandpa Pig creates a watering system; Mummy and Daddy Pig work hard in their home office; Peppa visits Cousin Chloe's house to play; at the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: The Sandcastle; Ice Cream; Jukebox; Windmills; Buried Treasure Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside; Mr Labrador has an ice cream van but runs out of ice cream; Peppa, George, Granny, and Grandpa Pig visit the sailing club, where they find a jukebox.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: Valentine's Day; Breakfast Club; The Perfect Day; Doctor Hamster's Big Present; The Time Capsule Daddy's Valentine's Day card from Mummy; Peppa and her friends have breakfast together; Peppa and her friends visit a shop of little shops; Peppa and her family take their fish for a checkup; Peppa and her friends make a time capsule.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S12 E07 — Search and Rescue: Pups Help the Chickens Cross the Road; Search and Rescue: Pups Save a Lost Ryder Chickaletta's family is scattered around town, causing traffic jams; the Safety and Rescue Pups have to help the chickens cross the road; Chase leads a mission to rescue a lost Ryder which involves clues, tools and Chewington.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S14 E03 — Pups Save a Splashy Bottom; Pups Save a Daring Tour Guide The Pups are on the case when mechanical issues occur at the new water park, Splashy Bottom; the Pups have to save ancient relics when hijinks ensue at Danny's new job at the Museum.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S05 E12 — The Crew Demolishes An Iceberg When the pups find kittens inside an old building, they think fast to bring the cats to safety before tearing the building down! / Motor's big drum performance in the symphony is almost ruined when the pups need to do loud demolition next door.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S12 E02 — Search and Rescue: Pups Save the Bike Race In Adventure Bay, a major bike race is underway, and nearly the entire town is participating; with so many bikes on the roads, maintaining safety is a challenge; Chase and his team of Safety and Rescue Pups are on the job.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: Strength Of Steel / Bubbles, Bubbles, Lots Of Trouble One of Professor Scratch's inventions makes Sir Steel too strong, causing him to wreak havoc; Kai's stowaway Bubble Alien causes problems when it gets wet and multiplies.
programme.title: Deer Squad

programme.desc: S08 E08 — The Snow, Sea, Sky Race Blaze and Crusher face off in an off-road showdown, the Snow, Sea, Sky Race; to win, the trucks will have to speed through the snow, swim through the sea and soar to a finish line high in the sky.
programme.title: Blaze and the Monster Machines

programme.desc: S13 E06 — Air Rescue: Pups Save the Mother Tree; Pups Save the Ice Cream Truck Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E22 — Pups Save a Floundering Francois; Pups Save the Pop-Up Penguins Cap'n Turbot and his cousin Francois are watching white whales in Adventure Bay when their boat hits a rock and starts to sink; the PAW Patrol must track down some loose penguins and help them return to the land of ice and snow.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: Stan's showtime / The Truth is Out There Stan claims to have a real Marsupilami appearing in a show he puts on, but it's a fake robot; Acu thinks a fish-loving alien lives in town, and Mica offers to help him track it down.
programme.title: The Marsupilamis

programme.desc: S07 E17 — Pups Save a Bah Humdinger Mayor Humdinger is being naughty on Christmas Eve, and the PAW Patrol has to save Christmas.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S04 E12 — The Crew Builds a Sporting Goods Store; The Crew Plays Construction Vehicle Soccer The crew help Coach Karima and Shopkeeper Shelley launch Builder Cove's first sporting goods store; the pups step in to help Farmer Zoe move a watermelon.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S08 E13 — Pups Save a Show Jumper; Pups Save the Salmon Winnie Winnington goes looking for a frog to enter in a frog-jumping contest and ends up needing to be rescued in a swamp; the pups try to help salmon get to an ocean and also need to rescue Alex.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: Parachute Games; Flying Discs; Kiddie Workout; Monkey Trees; Trampoline Peppa has fun playing parachute games at playgroup; Peppa learns how to throw and catch flying discs in the park; Mr. Potato leads the playgroup in a fun musical workout; Peppa visits an adventure park; Peppa has fun at a trampoline park.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: Children's Festival; Muddy Festival; World Book Day; Roman Day; Foggy Day Peppa and her family go to the children's festival; World Book Day at playgroup; Peppa has fun dressing up; Peppa and her family get lost in the fog.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: Lots of Muddy Puddles; Buttercups, Daisies, and Dandelions; The Marble Run; Mr. Potato Comes to Town; Shake, Rattle, and Bang Peppa looks for words to describe puddles; Chloe shows Peppa and George fun things to do with flowers; all the people in town are excited to meet Mr. Potato; Madame Gazelle brings lots of musical instruments.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: Cruise Ship Holiday; Holiday on the Sea; Tropical Day Trip; Sailing Home; Caves Peppa and George go on a cruise with the grandparents; Peppa meets Pirate Pete and Mrs. Mermaid; Peppa goes to an island full of souvenir stalls; the family has all gone to the caves for a day out, and Grampy Rabbit is their tour guide.
programme.title: Peppa Pig

programme.desc: S03 E11 — Pups Save the Polar Bears; A Pup in Sheep's Clothing The pups fly to the Arctic in order to rescue lost polar bear cubs; the Patrol needs to find lost sheep and learn who has been making holes in a fence.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S08 E20 — Rescue Knights Break the Ice; Pups Save Excalibark Claw finds a way to make Sparks' breath icy; Chase accidentally pulls the legendary Golden Bone of Excalibark from its stone.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S10 E15 — Pups Save a Baby Caribou; Pups Save Luke and His Luke-Alike When a baby caribou winds up speeding down a mountainside, it's up to the PAW Patrol to save the calf and reunite it with its family; when Luke Stars gets blown away in a giant tumbleweed, Digi and Tal make a duplicate which dances out of control.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S11 E13 — Pups Save the Big Book Delivery; Pups Save the Puppets Mayor Humdinger's kitties make off with Mayor Goodway's book delivery truck; Julius and Julia get into a sticky situation when the paper bag puppets they created for a puppet show become stuck on the antlers of a deer.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S05 E01 — Pups Save the Kitty Rescue Crew; Pups Save an Ostrich Mayor Humdinger creates fake emergencies for his kitties so they can appear better than the PAW Patrol; the Wingnuts get a new pet ostrich, but it gets lost on the trip home.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E11 — Pups Leave Marshall Home Alone; Pups Save the Deer Marshall must head out for a rescue on his own when Katie calls with an emergency; the PAW Patrol must rescue a family of deer who are stuck on the slippery ice.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Pups Pit Crew; Pups Fight Fire Ryder and the PAW Patrol must rescue Alex when he takes off on his new super trike; Marshall proves he is a true hero when he stops during a competition to put out a fire on the beach.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Pups Save the Space Alien; Pups Save a Flying Frog The PAW Patrol helps an extra-terrestrial after his spaceship crash lands at Farmer Yumi's place; the Pups come to the rescue when Smiley the frog jumps into Skye's helicopter.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S02 E10 — The Crew Builds a Ferris Wheel; The Crew Builds a Farm Animal Yoga Space Rubble and Crew want to give Grocer Gabriel the best beach day ever, including a ride on a brand-new Ferris wheel at the boardwalk; when Farmer Zoe's animals need some relaxation, the pups build a perfect place to practice yoga with Coach Karima.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S02 E09 — The Crew Builds a Smoothie Shop; The Crew Builds a Dino Roof Party Café Carl opens up a smoothie shop on the boardwalk, but when the coaster causes coconut chaos, "Rubble & Crew" know just what to do; "Rubble & Crew" work together to find a construction solution when Charger's bouncy birthday surprise needs a lift.
programme.title: Rubble & Crew

programme.desc: S01 E05 — Pup Pup Goose; Pup Pup and Away Marshall's new gosling friend gets lost; the PAW Patrol must rescue the mayor from a hot air balloon.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S06 E12 — Mighty Pups, Super Paws: Pups Meet the Mighty Twins When bandit Ladybird shrieks havoc in Adventure Bay and takes all the town's treasures, the Mighty Pups team up with new super pals, the Mighty Twins, to save the day -- and Mayor Goodway.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S07 E06 — Dino Rescue: Pups and the Lost Dino Eggs When a lost world of dinosaurs is discovered, Mayor Humdinger wants to take dino eggs back to Foggy Bottom, but along the way a baby Brachiosaurus ends up in dino-sized trouble.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S06 E04 — Pups Save the Honey; Pups Save Mayor Goodway's Purse Yumi's Yummy Honey is all the buzz when it -- and her beehive -- go missing from her farm; Mayor Goodway's purse disappears, along with its precious cargo, Chickaletta.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S11 E19 — Hum-Patrol to the Rescue!; Pups Save Morning Mountain Yoga When Adventure Bay holds a raffle, a pair of nest-building seagulls snatch the winning prize; a rockslide leaves Mayor Goodway, Farmer Yumi and Garby stranded on the side of a mountain.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S13 E13 — Fire Rescue Pups and the Missing Water Mystery; Pups Save a Squirrely Cabin Mr. Park's rooftop garden catches fire and there's no water in Adventure Bay; a trio of mischievous squirrels have concocted a plan to take over Jake's cozy mountain cabin.
programme.title: PAW Patrol

programme.desc: S06 E20 — The Solar Light Spectacular! When giant robot Buster steals all the batteries that power Solar City, which runs on the sun's energy, it's up to solar power workers Nonny and Goby to stop him and get the lights back on before the big light show is cancelled.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S05 E12 — Snow Squad to the Rescue! Gil is convinced a yeti is to blame when sleeping bags go missing.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E20 — Good Hair Day! Gil needs to get his hair cut before picture day.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S06 E21 — The Ultra Spy Tool! When supervillain Dr. Coldfinger takes Curly Q's newest invention, the Ultra Spy Tool, secret agents Molly, Goby and Spy Pup must travel across the world to find and infiltrate his North Pole lair.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S06 E25 — A Slow Day in Zippy City! Everything is fast in Zippy City, but when Tiny the Slug and the Opposites Crew slow everything down to the opposite of fast with sticky slime, detectives Zooli and Goby have to stop them before it's too late.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E15 — Bubble Duckies! Molly, Gil and a duckling named Beep help a family of ducks that are lost in a storm cloud.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S06 E16 — Search for the Great Silverback! When primatologists Zooli and Gil are looking in the rainforest for a silverback gorilla, they're chased into an ancient temple by a robotic silverback that turns out to be a tiny marmoset guarding a sanctuary of mountain gorillas.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S03 E21 — Puddleball! When rain spoils a game of kickball, Gil invents a new game; Bubble Puppy must overcome his fear of thunder to save the game.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E16 — Triple-Track Train Race! The Guppies must move fast when a herd of cows wanders onto the train tracks.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S01 E07 — The Moon Rocks! The Bubble Guppies learn about outer space.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.desc: S02 E11 — The Beach Ball! Molly's friend needs the Guppies' help to finish her work in time to attend the Big Beach Ball.
programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Bubble Guppies

programme.title: Tg1

programme.desc: Il pianista Stefano Bollani e l'attrice Valentina Cenni accolgono il pubblico in una casa in cui tutti vorremmo abitare: una casa fatta di musica, aperta ad amici e note, storie e sorrisi.
programme.title: Via dei Matti n° 0

programme.desc: La cucina come contesto in cui parlare di attualità con i numerosi ospiti in studio, tra i quali cuochi professionisti ed esperti di alimentazione, e giocare con il pubblico a casa.
programme.title: È sempre mezzogiorno

programme.desc: Selezione di cartoni animati a cura della rete: spazio di programmazione dedicato ai più piccoli.
programme.title: Cartoni animati

programme.desc: Natura, terra, mare, vento. I passi degli uomini che attraversano questa terra, i loro cibi, la loro difficile convivenza con l'ambiente che li circonda. La natura e l'ambiente, il futuro del nostro Pianeta e le tradizioni del nostro Paese.
programme.title: Geo

programme.desc: A 3 anni dalla tragica morte di Pietro Mori, Vittorio Conti investe le energie per riaprire il grande magazzino dell'amico. L'uomo si mette però in affari con la potente famiglia Guarnieri, gente senza scrupoli disposta a tutto.
programme.title: Il paradiso delle signore

programme.desc: Il famoso gioco dei pacchi, nel quale i concorrenti provenienti ciascuno da una regione diversa sfidano il banco per vincere un montepremi fino a 300.000 euro.
programme.title: Affari tuoi

programme.title: RAI News

programme.desc: Le storie e le intricate vicende degli abitanti di un condominio, Palazzo Paladini, situato sulla collina partenopea di Posillipo, stretta tra il luccicante mare di Napoli e il Vesuvio.
programme.title: Un posto al sole

programme.desc: Le vicende biografiche di Pierdante Piccioni, il primario che, in seguito a un incidente stradale, è rimasto in coma per diversi anni. Al suo risveglio, i suoi ricordi erano svaniti.

programme.desc: S04 E05 — Store Wars With the Casagrandes; Lucha Fever With the Casagrandes When a fancy grocery store opens on the block, Bobby rallies the family to do everything they can to compete; Ronnie Anne fakes being sick to watch a Lucha Libre match, which proves to be more difficult than anticipated.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S03 E21 — Really Loud Music Hoping to win a songwriting contest, Luna contemplates whether she should go with a song that's true to her sound or try to make something that the whole world will love.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S05 E21 — Appetite for Destruction; Frame on You When Lily starts misbehaving at home, Mom and Dad think her new preschool friends might be the cause; when Rusty is wrongfully suspended, the Action News Team leaps into action to clear his name.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S01 E10 — Sound of Silence; Space Invader Lincoln uses sound-canceling ear buds to try and drown out his sisters; after Lynn and Lucy get in a fight, Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room for one night.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S10 E01 — Summer Camp: The Grate Outdoors; Summer Camp: Don't Lose Your Cool At Camp Mastodon, Lynn pushes an overly-cautious Lisa to become more adventurous; when Lori learns her Camp Mastodon campers think she's uncool, she tries to impress them by breaking the rules.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S06 E05 — A Bug's Strife; All the Rage Dad tears the house apart trying to find the cricket ruining his peaceful day alone in the house; tired of getting pummeled during dodgeball, Lincoln and the gang use Clyde's untapped rage without him knowing.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S02 E05 — Lock 'N Loud; The Whole Picture When Dad gets upset with the children for never locking the front door, they decide to take home security to the next level; when Lincoln accidentally erases his childhood photos, he and Clyde attempt to recreate them before his memory fades.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S04 E12 — Stall Monitor; A Pimple Plan Worried that his teacher has bad things to say about him, Lincoln tries to delay his parent-teacher conference; Luan wakes up with a pimple on the day of her first date with Benny, so she turns to the siblings for help.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S05 E23 — Diss the Cook; For Sale by Loner Lincoln is convinced the middle school lunch lady is holding a grudge against him and his older sisters; Mr. Grouse attempts to find some peace and quiet after moving away from the Louds.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S05 E16 — Camped! When Dad discovers that his childhood camp is closing, he decides to take the family for one final visit; they soon uncover a map that could lead to a treasure big enough to save the camp and prove the existence of an old camp legend.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S06 E22 — Snow Escape; Snow News Day To make it to school, the Louds must survive a monstrous Lynn when the weatherman declares it a Packing Day; when there are signs of a yeti in Royal Woods, the Action News Team sets out to prove its existence.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S02 E02 — 11 Louds a Leapin' As the Louds prepare for Christmas, Lincoln's sled goes into their neighbor's yard, leading Lincoln and Clyde to attempt a rescue mission.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S07 E17 — Twas the Fight Before Christmas Lincoln recruits his cousins to help end the years-long feud between Dad and Uncle Lance so they can finally celebrate Christmas together.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S04 E26 — A Star Is Scorned; Senior Moment Lola realizes that double the cuteness could help her break into show business, so she teams up with Lily; Lori vows to make up for lost time in her senior year.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S02 E26 — Snow Way Out; Snow Way Down Lana convinces the children to go to the Burpin' Burger to meet her racecar driving hero despite the heavy snowfall; when Lincoln goes on vacation with Clyde, he realizes how overprotective Clyde's parents are.
programme.title: The Loud House

programme.desc: S09 E02 — Merry Diss-mass; Just Snow With It Lynn is excited for her Swiss friend Henrik to visit, but she grows nervous when people think they're more than friends; Lincoln and friends start a shoveling business to raise money for David Steele on Ice tickets.
programme.title: The Loud House
